steps.content: Sometimes you dream of what happened back then.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: Given how immature these shackles are... you're pretty persistent...

steps.speaker: Corpseborne
steps.content: I see, you're... you're the same...

steps.speaker: Corpseborne
steps.content: But you're just a defective!
In the dreams, the frenzied words buzz from afar, as if blocked out by frosted glass.
And right before your eyes, above the sea of flowers, the white box you've seen before is floating in the air.
The bane of the disasters, the root of the mysteries, the entrance to the abyss... It's right there before your eyes, yet it's unreachable.
...It only appears in your dreams, and you don't know why.

steps.speaker: Screening Officer
steps.content: Answer my questions, ${PlayerName}.
The knocks on the desk pull you back to reality. In the claustrophobic interrogation room, through the speaker, the interrogator's low voice hits the black walls.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The same interrogations have been going over and over again for too long. It's going to reach one's limit at some point.
After a brief silence, he speaks again, his voice even lower this time.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: You're not the MBCC's chief now, you're a <color=#fb9259>suspect</color> who's been suspended and under investigation. If you don't want further and harsher interrogations, spill the beans now.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: Tell me everything you saw about the Black Ring.
Just like that dream, these fruitless conversations have been repeated many times too.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I've said everything I ought to say.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: But that's not everything.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: While BR-004 was active, you lost contact with the outside world in the Black Ring. Meanwhile, all Sinners in the MBCC who were linked to you through the shackles went manic multiple times. All of them, at the same time.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: What did you do?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You can ask the Black Ring what it did to me.
Through the speaker, you hear tapping sounds on a keyboard.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: Your adjutant and Sinners all believe you destroyed BR-004. How did you do it?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: ...I destroyed ground zero of the Black Ring.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Something like the inheritance in the crypt corrupted the Sinners and turned them into a monster named Corpseborne. That was the center of the Black Ring.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We defeated it, and the Black Ring subsided.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: ...We only found the corpse of a male Sinner at the scene. Signs of deep corruption were identified on his body, but the thing that corrupted him had been forcibly stripped off him.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: Where did Zoya go? And the whereabouts of the inheritance you just mentioned?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I don't know. I blacked out after defeating the Corpseborne.

steps.content: In this interrogation room like a black iron box, you only hear the lifeless ticking sound of a second hand coming from the other end of the speaker, punching on your nerves with each tick.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: ...You're still keeping your mouth zipped, aren't you? This kind of attitude won't do you any good.
But letting them know you've absorbed the inheritance will do you even less good. It's a dangerous secret even you yourself haven't been able to comprehend, a secret you can't share with anyone.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: We know an <color=#fb9259>underground organization</color> is attempting to create Black Rings in the city. The DisCity's most merciless agents are watching them and making sure of their eventual deaths.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: Now, think twice. The more you resist, the more suspicious you'll become. If someone thinks you're related to those people behind the Black Ring...

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: You should expect a different kind of interrogation by a different party.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Then on whose behalf are you interrogating me now?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The City Council's officials? The sheriff's hound? Or the FAC's enforcer? I've destroyed the Black Ring, and I've said enough about it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you're trying to get to those behind the Black Ring, why don't you first question the sheriffs? What did Burns have to do with them? And what did they do in Syndicate?

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: ...Don't try to use your tricks in the Bureau on me. I'm the one interrogating you now.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: Now, FAC Special Operations Forces Against Black Rings, captain of team N7, service number <color=#fb9259>036</color>. Let's talk about him.
Your breath freezes the second you hear the name.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: During the last round of interrogation, you admitted to accidentally killing 036 in a chaotic mental state under the Black Ring's influence. This is your most honest response during the entire interrogation process.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: You've expressed your regrets and apologies to his family, let's start from there. Now, answer the questions we've encountered during further investigation.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: Forensic examination reveals that the fatal wound on 036 was the one on his heart, pierced through by contamination crystal. Both on-site investigation and wound analysis show clearly that he did not plunge onto the spike himself.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: It's evident that it happened very suddenly, 036 stood still and had his heart pierced through by the Ring's extremely aggressive contamination crystal. Something controlled the spike to kill him.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: Explain this to me, ${PlayerName}. Under such circumstances, why did you admit <color=#fb9259>you</color> are the one who accidentally killed him?

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: From your response to his family, it doesn't look like you're harboring the real culprit. Tell me, did 036 take the bullet for you?

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: Or, were <color=#fb9259>you</color> the one who controlled the Ring's contamination and stabbed him?
You recall flashbacks of 036 before his death. The body pierced through by the spike, the bloodstained photo, and the hand reaching out to you at the last moment...

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: Tell me, why were you able to control the contamination inside the Black Ring? You've said that's the power belonging solely to the Corpseborne, the Black Ring's owner.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: ...Because the shackles linked me and Zoya together.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: That would only enable the Black Ring to destroy your mind one-sidedly. How were you able to turn it around and influence it?

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: Stop making excuses like this. Since the day the FAC launched this project, we've been monitoring you. We know you come with great risks, and this incident is only a small warning.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: What exactly is the relation between you and the Black Ring? How are you related to the Corpseborne, that inheritance thing... and the power behind the Black Ring?!
To your surprise, you laugh under the immense pressure. Handling this matter with such seriousness, they must know even more than you do.
They dread and fear you, but they must get you to work with them. This reminds you of the Sinners. Facing this kind of scenario, they'd never bow down easily.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: Answer my questions!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: How can I give you the answers when I don't even know them?
You can look for the answers yourself.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're wasting your time locking me up here. If you want the answers, why don't you just give it another try?

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: ...What are you trying to say?

Having been through that incident, you no longer care about these trivial things now. They can guard against you or try to torture answers out of you. But they are just a bunch of strangers overcome by cowardice who want things from you.
You have your own answers to look for, about the cause of that disaster, the mastermind behind it, and your own mysteries.
All these answers lie in the Black Ring.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I have a proposal for someone who has say over things.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: ...You can say it here.
You snicker.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Let me out, take me to another Black Ring.

steps.content: The Black Ring in the square is number 004, right? That means the other Black Rings before it must exist in this city and are being carefully watched. Take me to one of them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll try my best to get rid of it. And this time, look for its cause and the answers to your questions. You may even be able to spot the mastermind behind it, the one you've been trying hard to find.
...And everything you want to know.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: ...You haven't even come clean about yourself, and you're dreaming of winning our trust?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: If you have so many doubts about me, why don't you just kill me?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's exactly because you can't kill me, you must push me so hard and control everything about me. You need me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Because you can't do anything with the Black Rings. I'm the only one who can destroy them.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: You...
His words are interrupted by chuckling sounds. You hear a few metallic knocks on the floor. The chair moves and someone stands up—a woman begins speaking.
What a waste, such a talent has fallen in your grip.
End this pointless interrogation now. From now on, he's mine.
steps.female_content: End this pointless interrogation now. From now on, she's mine.

steps.content: As she speaks, she cuts off the comms and blocks out the interrogator's angry shouts.
Soon, the interrogation room's door opens and a woman wearing a hat walks in.
Her cane knocks on the floor, the sound piercing through the entire room like a sharp blade.
Hello, newbie. My name is <color=#fb9259>Langley</color>. I'm in charge of the <color=#fb9259>9th Agency</color>. I'm an agent, and also someone...

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: who has say over things, as you've requested.
Langley walks toward you and lifts the brim of her hat gently, looking at you with a smile.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: I know you're keeping quite a few secrets, but that's okay. I like your proposal. Very much, in fact...

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: No time to waste. Let's go.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Where you want to be, an existing Black Ring.
